main.description: One person's reaction to an is.dame.experiment. Lives on the REACTOR's repo and points at the experiment through `subject`, so backlink indexers (Constellation et al.) can gather the reactions without a central database. One reaction per person per experiment: a reader shows the newest and ignores the rest, and the reference UI replaces the old record when a reaction is changed.

subject.description: The at-uri of the is.dame.experiment record being reacted to.

reaction.description: The verdict. more: build this, I want it. curious: interested, not sold yet. pass: not for me. An open set, so a reader should show a value it doesn't know as plain text or leave it out of the tally, never fail.

text.description: Optional note: what would make it better, what it reminded them of, why not. Plain text.
